# A page's path is held to the struct that says what the page hands its
# content: every `{name}` names a field, and that field is something a route can
# parse out of text.
#
# Both questions belong to html and not to the checker. A path is a plain
# string until something serves it -- `href` is an ordinary prop on every other
# target, and `{pkg}` is only a placeholder because a route reads it that way.
# The checker asked them anyway, which is the compiler knowing what html knows:
# a page built for bubbletea got a diagnostic about a path nothing routes.
#
# So these are build errors now, and they arrive only for the target that has
# routes. That also makes them reachable by `--lang none`, which serves the
# page as a file: the placeholder is refused there for a different reason
# (route_param_static_refused.txt), so this asks --lang go.
#
# The other direction is held too: a field the path names no placeholder for
# is refused, since a page's params all travel in its path
# (nav_html_refused.txt).

! sngl generate --lang go --platform html -o out-missing missing.sngl
stderr 'page "a"''s href /p/\{slug\} names \{slug\}, but its params have no field "slug"'

! sngl generate --lang go --platform html -o out-unparseable unparseable.sngl
stderr 'page "b"''s href /t/\{tags\} names \{tags\}, which arrives as text, and field "tags" is list<string>, which a path cannot carry'

# A path naming every field, each of a type it can carry, is served.
sngl generate --lang go --platform html -o out-ok ok.sngl

-- missing.sngl --
import "sngl:platform/html"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    go {
        html
    }
}

struct PageParams {
    pkg string
    page int
    tags list<string>
}

ui.window(title=pages.current.title) {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #a(href=`/p/{slug}`, title="t", params=PageParams{}) {
            component content(v) {
                html.span(innerText=v.pkg)
            }
        }
    }
}

-- unparseable.sngl --
import "sngl:platform/html"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    go {
        html
    }
}

struct PageParams {
    pkg string
    page int
    tags list<string>
}

ui.window(title=pages.current.title) {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #b(href=`/t/{tags}`, title="t", params=PageParams{}) {
            component content(v) {
                html.span(innerText=v.pkg)
            }
        }
    }
}

-- ok.sngl --
import "sngl:platform/html"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    go {
        html
    }
}

struct PageParams {
    pkg string
    page int
}

ui.window(title=pages.current.title) {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #c(href=`/p/{pkg}/{page}`, title="t", params=PageParams{}) {
            component content(v) {
                html.span(innerText=v.pkg)
            }
        }
    }
}
